name: Google Calendar
summary: Read a Google user's calendars, events and free/busy times through the Google Calendar API v3.

client_id.description: the OAuth client id of a Google Cloud OAuth app with the Google Calendar API enabled (Google Cloud console > APIs & Services > Credentials)

refresh_token.description: a refresh token minted with that OAuth app for a Calendar scope: https://www.googleapis.com/auth/calendar.readonly to read, https://www.googleapis.com/auth/calendar.events to also create events

notes: Own-account API: reads the calendars of the Google user who granted the refresh token. 'primary' names that user's main calendar.
Times are RFC3339 with an offset (2026-11-09T09:00:00-05:00 or ...Z). All-day events use start.date/end.date instead of dateTime, and end is exclusive.
Lists page with pageToken/nextPageToken; a nextSyncToken on the last page lets a later call fetch only changes.

endpoints.name: List the user's calendars
endpoints.summary: Calendars on the user's calendar list, with id, summary, time zone and access role.

minAccessRole.description: Only calendars where the user has at least this role.

endpoints.name: List events
endpoints.summary: Events on a calendar in a time window, optionally expanded into single occurrences and searched by text.

calendarId.description: Calendar id; 'primary' is the signed-in user's main calendar. Others from calendars.list.

timeMin.description: Exclusive lower bound on event END time, RFC3339 with offset.

timeMax.description: Exclusive upper bound on event START time, RFC3339 with offset.

q.description: Free text over summary, description, location, attendee and organizer names and emails.

singleEvents.description: Expand recurring events into their instances; default false.

timeZone.description: IANA time zone for the response; default the calendar's.

updatedMin.description: Only events modified after this RFC3339 time (deleted ones always included).

iCalUID.description: Find an event by its iCalendar id.

maxAttendees.description: Cap on attendees returned per event.

syncToken.description: nextSyncToken from a previous full list, to get only changes; not combinable with time, q, orderBy or updatedMin filters. 410 means start over.

notes: Pages can hold fewer than maxResults events; keep following nextPageToken until it is absent.
Without singleEvents=true a recurring event comes back once, as its rule, not as each occurrence.

endpoints.name: Get an event
endpoints.summary: One event by id: time, attendees and their responses, location, conference link and description.

calendarId.description: Calendar id; 'primary' is the signed-in user's main calendar. Others from calendars.list.

timeZone.description: IANA time zone for the response.

endpoints.name: Query free/busy
endpoints.summary: Busy intervals for up to 50 calendars or groups over a time range.

timeZone.description: Time zone of the response; default UTC.

groupExpansionMax.description: Most calendar ids to expand per group, at most 100.

calendarExpansionMax.description: Most calendars to return, at most 50.
